name: Arctic Confrontation
description: A near-peer adversary has established illegal military installations on contested Arctic islands and is enforcing a Northern Sea Route blockade. US and allied forces must project power above the Arctic Circle.

objectives.title: Freedom of Navigation
objectives.description: Assert US navigation rights in the Northern Sea Route.

objectives.title: Destroy Illegal Installations
objectives.description: Neutralize adversary military installations on contested islands.

objectives.title: ASW Operations
objectives.description: Clear adversary submarine threat from Norwegian Sea.

ADVERSARY_A.name: Northern Fleet
ADVERSARY_A.description: Arctic-capable naval forces. Borei SSBNs, Oscar II SSGNs, Kirov battlecruisers.

events.title: Northern Fleet Surge Confirmed
events.body: Satellite imagery confirms Russian Northern Fleet sortie from Severomorsk. Kirov-class battlecruiser, 3 Udaloy-class ASW destroyers, and Oscar II SSGN detected transiting into Norwegian Sea.

events.title: NSR Blockade Declared
events.body: Russia has formally declared the Northern Sea Route a restricted military zone. Non-Russian commercial shipping forbidden. NATO allies protest — no military response yet. Freedom of navigation operation authorized.

events.title: Borei SSBN Deployment Detected
events.body: SOSUS arrays detect acoustic signature of Borei-class SSBN transiting Arctic Basin toward patrol station. SSBN represents strategic deterrent — ROE: do not engage unless attacked.

events.title: Russian SAM Battery Fires Warning Shot
events.body: S-400 battery on Novaya Zemlya fired air defense warning shots at NATO P-8A conducting ISR. Aircraft not hit but ROE escalation authorized. Air defense suppression operations may commence.

events.title: NATO Article 5 Consultations
events.body: NATO Secretary General convenes Article 5 consultations after Norwegian frigate is lased by Russian aircraft. Unanimous declaration that further provocations will trigger collective defense response.

events.title: Oscar II Launch Position Identified
events.body: UKUSA SIGINT triangulates Oscar II SSGN position in Barents Sea. P-8A Poseidon now tracking. ASW prosecution window open — 6 hours before predicted transition to Norwegian Sea.

victory_conditions.DEFEAT: US forces sustain >50% attrition or withdraw
